# awscc_bcmpricingcalculator_workload_estimate (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::BcmPricingCalculator::WorkloadEstimate



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the workload estimate.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) The timestamp when the workload estimate will expire.
- `rate_type` (String) The type of pricing rates used for the estimate.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the workload estimate.
- `cost_currency` (String) The currency of the estimated cost.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the workload estimate was created.
- `failure_message` (String) An error message if the workload estimate failed.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `rate_timestamp` (String) The timestamp of the pricing rates used for the estimate.
- `status` (String) The current status of the workload estimate.
- `total_cost` (Number) The total estimated cost for the workload.
- `workload_estimate_id` (String) The unique identifier of the workload estimate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_bcmpricingcalculator_workload_estimate.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```
